CSI Careers & Opportunities

Make social Change & have fun doing it

If you can take on tough jobs with agility and humour, you're in the right place.

The CSI team supports our members, builds a future that puts people and planet first, cleans up spilled oat milk, builds connections, and throws some really great parties. Collaboration is at our core. We know that strengthening the social innovation sector and proving solutions are possible take each and every one of us.

If you're excited by the work we do at CSI, check out our open employment and exchange opportunities now. If you're looking for jobs from our members, check our the community job board
